title: Thank You and Gratitude in the Live Stream
originalTitle: 【WINE PARTY 雑談】CELEBRATE SHIMASHOU, MINNA. wine and chill with my dead beats.
lead: The speaker expresses gratitude to the audience for their support, acknowledging that not everyone may enjoy their content. They also highlight the strengths of their team and encourage listeners to check out a resource, even though they personally do not like it.
summaryOneLine: The speaker expresses gratitude to the audience for their support, acknowledging that not everyone may enjoy their content. They also highlight the strengths of their team and encourage listeners to check out a resource, even though they personally do not like it.
articleBodyHtml:
Acknowledging Support and Gratitude

The speaker expresses gratitude to the audience for their support, acknowledging that not everyone may enjoy their content. They also highlight the strengths of their team and encourage listeners to check out a resource, even though they personally do not like it.

The speaker learned about the resource through a podcast and was taught the correct pronunciation by multiple people who had previously learned about it through the same podcast. They acknowledge this knowledge as 'mean' but also admit that others may enjoy the resource.

Engagement with the Audience

The speaker asks about the listener's progress in learning Japanese, and the listener responds that it is 'decent.' This shows that the listener is actively trying to improve their language skills.

The speaker also mentions their desire to have fun with the audience while fulfilling their duties, and they express a genuine sense of happiness from the interaction.

Ending the Stream and Sleep

The speaker asks the audience not to end the stream, but they also mention that they need to sleep because they have a show the next day. This creates a sense of conflict between wanting to continue the stream and needing to rest.

The audience is divided in their reactions, with some telling the speaker to go to sleep and others encouraging them to stay up. The speaker is grateful for the support but also feels conflicted about being a 'valuable existence' to the audience.

Gratitude and Handling Criticism

The speaker emphasizes that they are grateful for the audience's support and does not want to make anyone uncomfortable. They also acknowledge that not all criticism is negative and that they need to improve on handling the audience's kind support in a natural and balanced way.

Final Gratitude and Farewell

The speaker thanks the audience for attending the live stream and expresses gratitude for the support they have received. They also mention a deceased individual, expressing both sadness and gratitude for the support from others.

At the end of the stream, someone exclaims 'Fuck it!' or 'Fuck it.' This shows a moment of frustration or release, possibly related to the stream ending or the speaker needing to sleep.
